mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ORG_IDENTITY FROM LEAGUE_ORGANIZATION WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(ORG_IDENTITY)) > 0 AND (PARENT_ID IS NULL OR PARENT_ID <> '-1') ORDER BY ORG_IDENTITY

SELECT ID, LEAGUE_NAME, ATTRIBUTE_02 AS DEPT_ID, ATTRIBUTE_01 AS DEPT_NAME FROM LEAGUE_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORG_IDENTITY = #{orgIdentity} AND (PARENT_ID IS NULL OR PARENT_ID <> '-1') ORDER BY TREE_SORTS, TREE_SORT, ID
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(TO_CHAR(HYRQ, 'YYYY') AS INTEGER) AS MEETING_YEAR FROM DYN_TWSHYK WHERE ORG_IDENTITY = #{orgIdentity} AND HYRQ IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MEETING_YEAR DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LEAGUE_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORG_IDENTITY = #{orgIdentity} AND (PARENT_ID IS NULL OR PARENT_ID <> '-1')
SELECT ID, LEAGUE_NAME FROM LEAGUE_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORG_IDENTITY = #{orgIdentity} AND (PARENT_ID IS NULL OR PARENT_ID <> '-1') AND ID = #{leagueId} ORDER BY TREE_SORTS, TREE_SORT, ID
